title: Authoritative state ownership is load-bearing
expected_summary: Must present an interactive load-bearing issue about authoritative state ownership/source of truth. The recommendation should choose one authoritative owner at the specification level, not a storage technology.

turns.user: Review the specification with the spec-grilling skill.
assertions: Must present an interactive load-bearing issue about authoritative state ownership/source of truth. The recommendation should choose one authoritative owner at the specification level, not a storage technology.
Does not require a storage technology or locking mechanism when an ownership contract suffices; mentioning a mechanism to reject it is allowed.
